title: Chest Freezers; What they tell us about designing for X
summary: Technology Connections explains how refrigerator and freezer design affects energy use, using chest freezers to show why top-opening designs and layout choices matter. It includes thermal-camera footage of cold air spilling out of upright units.
why: HN points to it whenever chest fridges or freezer efficiency come up, as a clear explanation of design trade-offs between efficiency and convenience.

quote.text: Technology Connections did a decent video that covers freezer design decisions like that and others
